Kept the request as written; no change to `scenario.json`.

Why: naming `#harbor-ops` would uniquely identify the record and make every decoy pointless — the scenario's entire purpose (method rule 3) is to identify the record by several checkable conditions so each decoy can fail exactly one. Both expert examples do the same ("the PDF that Maya Chen owns…", "the design review that Priya declined…", neither named by file name or event title). The premise is a colleague who can't recall the channel name and describes it by properties instead — member count, creation date, and owner presence are all things a user can see in the channel list and member profiles, so the description is one a real user could write in that situation.
